posts.t:
Hi Haanz,

As the price movement in the red circle actually broke the SR in this example, I'd say that it is indeed this piece that is the FL. This is what's holding price down, there could easily be a set of orders above the FTR, and price could go and pick it up.

If you look at it strictly, the FTR is the break of the SR of the FL and therefore a FL in itself. Ergo, FTR = FL, FL = FTR. It's all the same. It's a matter of determining what is the more important FL and in this case I'd say it's the FL in the red circle since it broke a more significant SR, and it is keeping price down for now. In real life, we should see wether or not there are clean orders left in the FL.

چون حرکت قیمت در دایرهٔ قرمز در این مثال واقعاً SR را شکست، می‌گویم همان تکه واقعاً FL است. همین چیزی است که قیمت را پایین نگه می‌دارد؛ می‌تواند به‌راحتی مجموعه‌ای از سفارش‌ها بالای FTR باشد و قیمت برود آن را بردارد.

اگر دقیق نگاه کنی، FTR شکست SR مربوط به FL است و در نتیجه خودش FL است. بنابراین، FTR = FL، FL = FTR. همه یک چیز است. مسئله تعیین این است که FL مهم‌تر کدام است و در این مورد می‌گویم FL در دایرهٔ قرمز است چون SR معنادارتری را شکست و فعلاً قیمت را پایین نگه می‌دارد. در زندگی واقعی باید ببینیم آیا سفارش‌های تمیزی در FL باقی مانده یا نه.

Hello,

I haven't finished reading this entire thread yet (on page 27 at the mo') but wanted to post up my first attempt at the homework. I'll catch up asap:)

Thanks,

Mark

This is the Daily chart where I identified 5 daily highs, and the FLs I believe were formed as each high was broken. I drilled down on H4 to find the high and low of the FL where it wasn't clear on the D1 chart. I then noted what happened on the FTB and subsequent visits to each FL.

The above shows the levels I looked into. Blue dotted lines for the highs that were broken. Red rectangles for the FLs, numbered 1 to 5.

This is the first FL, showing 2 bounces on reaction to it.

2nd one had two good reactions and one 'almost touched':)

Two good reactions to this one.

This one, I'm guessing was of lesser importance. Sadly I don't have history to the left in this case as I started at the beginning of this chart. There was no reaction on return to it, and another, larger FL was created immediately above it, which generated lots of fun reactions!

This 5th one was the money maker, with 4 or 5 good chances to trade bounces from the top of it. When it finally broke, it also went straight through the level below.

I thought it was worth drilling into the LTFs to see if there was any reaction at all the the 4th level, but could not see anything.

So, in conclusion, level 4 sucks, and I need to base my next homework on levels with more history:)
